messages:
nina: Hi team — PR #421 CI is red on the linux unit-tests job only. Anyone have a quick command to retrigger just the failing job? Want to avoid a full rebuild if possible.

chris: You can ask the CI bot to rerun just that job. In our org we use: ` /ci rerun --job=unit-tests ` (slash command in Slack) or via CLI: `gh run rerun <run-id> --job "unit-tests"` for GitHub Actions.

sam: If it was flaky for me I usually do the GH CLI. Get the run id from the checks link: `gh run list --repo org/repo` then `gh run rerun 123456 --job "unit-tests"`. That avoids re-running integration jobs.

maria: Note: "rerun" replays the job steps. If you need to rebuild artifacts (e.g., compiled wheels) use the rebuild path: `ci-bot rebuild --preserve-cache --jobs=unit-tests`. Rebuild will recreate the build step artifacts but keep caches, so sometimes fixes toolchain flakiness.

chris: Also FYI, we have a partial rerun helper script in tools/ci/retry_job.sh if you want to target Buildkite runs:
```bash
./tools/ci/retry_job.sh <build-number> "unit-tests"
```
It keeps the same docker image and reuses the cached workspace.

nina: Thanks — I tried `gh run rerun 987654 --job "unit-tests"` and ci-bot acknowledged.

ci-bot: queued rerun for job 'unit-tests' (run 987655) — estimated start in 12s :rocket:

maria: If the rerun fails again, please paste the job log URL and mark it flaky in the PR description like `flaky-tests: unit-tests` so we can annotate and schedule a bisect if needed.

nina: rerun passed :tada: — looks like a transient npm install timeout. Going to push a small timeout bump in the pipeline config to avoid repeats. Thanks y'all.

chris: Nice. For future quick reference, pinned snippet in #eng-infra is `/ci rerun --job=<name>` and `/ci rebuild --jobs=<name> --preserve-cache` — use rebuild only if artifacts need to be regenerated.

nina: closing the PR after merge. Cheers!
